name: Iraq
description: Iraq, the land of Mesopotamia, from Sumer, Akkad and Babylon to the Abbasid caliphs of Baghdad, the Ottomans, the kingdom, Saddam Hussein and the wars.

checkpoints.name: Mesopotamia
checkpoints.note: Writing and cities began in Sumer. Akkad, Babylon and Assyria ruled empires, and Nebuchadnezzar built Babylon's great walls.

checkpoints.name: Persians to caliphs
checkpoints.note: Persians, Greeks and Parthians ruled. Then the Abbasid caliphs built Baghdad, a world centre of learning, until the Mongols sacked it.

checkpoints.name: Ottomans and Britain
checkpoints.note: The land declined and later fell to the Ottomans. Britain made it a kingdom in 1921, independent in 1932.

checkpoints.name: Republic and wars
checkpoints.note: The monarchy fell in 1958. Saddam Hussein led Iraq into wars with Iran and Kuwait, the 2003 invasion toppled him, and the country fought off the Islamic State.
